title: 四种引用的层级与可达性判定：强/软/弱/虚
expected_output:
=== reference class hierarchy (Reference -> subclass) ===
    Strongish
    SoftReference -> Reference
    WeakReference -> Reference
    PhantomReference -> Reference
=== reaching states WITHOUT triggering GC ===
    strong reference alive            : true
    soft.get() != null (no pressure)  : true
    weak.get() != null (no GC yet)    : true
    phantom.get() == null (spec)      : true
    soft is enqueued now              : false
    phantom is enqueued now           : false
=== reachability classification (pure model, deterministic) ===
    strongly reachable -> never collected
    softly  reachable -> collected only under memory pressure
    weakly  reachable -> collected at the next GC
    phantom reachable -> already finalized, queue used as death notice
ThreadLocal leak root cause: key is weak (collected), value is strongly held by the Entry -> value leaks until remove()
